summary: Council amendment converted a proposed ban into a moratorium running to Jan 31, 2028 or until comprehensive legislation is adopted; creates a work group and repeals the personal property tax assessment reduction for qualified data storage centers; projects in development and future phases of existing campuses on adjacent lots exempt. Final hearing and vote Oct 5, 2026.

source.citation: Anne Arundel County bill page; Baltimore Sun; GovTech; WMAR (Sept 21-23, 2026)

notes: Update to existing entry. CONFLICT: some outlets report the moratorium as enacted; the county bill page shows only the amendment adopted. Forward calendar: Oct 5.
confidence_note: Bill page status via research report; amended bill text not read.
